llm_response.reason: The website claims to sell high-end goods (Isabel Marant) under a suspicious domain not linked to the official brand. It lists no verifiable business contact info, uses urgency and promise of free delivery to entice buyers, and has ambiguous customer privacy claims. The URL and site structure mimic a legitimate shop but lack critical details typical of real online stores, fitting several scam characteristics such as non-existent companies and targeting human psychological weaknesses with attractive offers.
